Package neqsim.mcp.runners

Class SILRunner

java.lang.Object
neqsim.mcp.runners.SILRunner
public final class SILRunner extends Object
MCP runner for bounded Safety Instrumented Function (SIF) PFD screening.

Computes average probability of failure on demand from caller-supplied component data and delegates SIL-band classification to NeqSim's canonical SafetyInstrumentedFunction and SILVerificationResult. The result is screening evidence only: it does not select or approve a SIL, verify lifecycle assumptions, demonstrate standards conformance, or replace independent functional-safety assessment.

Version:
1.1
Author:
